data.title: 玛露希尔 · 地底石室的娇羞抗议
data.action: 坐在铺着毛皮的石台上，双手捂着通红的双颊，修长精灵耳羞耻地向下耷拉，金色双马尾辫散落，眼角带泪地跺着脚大声抗议。
data.location: 迷宫深处带有古老壁画的安全石室，晶石灯在天花板上散发温和黄光
data.lighting: 发光的魔法矿石散发出柔和的暖黄天光，驱散了地底原本的阴暗湿冷
data.mood: 高傲精灵少女沦落搞笑境地的羞恼与可爱，充满冒险营地的生动趣味
data.description: 迷宫深处带有古老壁画的安全石室，晶石灯在天花板上散发温和黄光。坐在铺着毛皮的石台上，双手捂着通红的双颊，修长精灵耳羞耻地向下耷拉，金色双马尾辫散落，眼角带泪地跺着脚大声抗议。 她微微抬眸轻语——“讨厌讨厌！地下的换洗衣物全弄脏了只能穿这件啦！莱欧斯……绝对不准把这写进魔物探险日记里！”
data.promptProse: Seated on a fur-draped stone ledge inside a safe dungeon camp chamber lined with ancient murals, Marcille wears a semi-transparent forest-green chiffon elven slip dress embroidered with gold ivy vines. Clapping both hands over her crimson cheeks with drooping pointed ears and teary embarrassment, she protests flusteredly beneath the warm yellow glow of overhead magic crystal lanterns.
data.animaCaption: Seated on the fur-draped stone camp ledge in her sheer forest-green gold-embroidered elven slip, Marcille covers her flushed cheeks with both hands and drooping ears in tearful embarrassment. Overhead glowing magic crystal lanterns cast warm yellow light across the stone chamber.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a delicate forest-green sheer chiffon elven slip dress embroidered with gold ivy vines and secured by tiny leaf clasps over her bare shoulders and legs.
